LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.label: solar recon armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorRecon.description:
Partially-powered armor, designed for mobility and ease-of-use. Meshes of Sunsteel Weave block attacks without adding excessive weight, and a complex endomuscular system in the lower body allows for uncompromised movement.
Armor such as this is often employed by solar scout troops and higher-end police forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.label: solar recon helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetRecon.descr: A high-tech sunsteel helmet with integrated optics and hardened weave plating. Built for scouting and rapid deployments where visibility and survivability both matter.
